description: A dotenvx-encrypted env file, committed on purpose: every value is ECIES ciphertext sealed to DOTENV_PUBLIC_KEY, and the private key lives in the git-ignored .env.keys (Supabase's own dotenvx example ships three such files). Fails without the fix: the entropy scanner reported the encrypted: values on lines 8 and 9 as critical leaked secrets (line 10 is past the dotenv value cap), and the public key on line 5 as well.
